title: Add weight NaN/Infinity/range validation to persona endpoints (SEC-004)
description: rsCreateCustomPersonaEndpoint accepts weight parameters without checking for NaN, Infinity, or out-of-range values. adjustPersonaWeights can propagate NaN from tainted persona data. Add validateWeight guards and NaN safety.
action: In reader-endpoints.ts: (1) Import validateWeight from input-validation.js; (2) In rsCreateCustomPersonaEndpoint, after line 548 numeric check, add validateWeight calls for each of plotWeight, characterWeight, styleWeight, pacingWeight, toleranceThreshold with min=0 max=1; if any returns non-null, return that error response; (3) In adjustPersonaWeights function line 841, replace 'const currentWeight = (persona.parameters[paramKey] as number | undefined) ?? 0.5' with 'const raw = persona.parameters[paramKey]; const currentWeight = (typeof raw === 'number' && Number.isFinite(raw)) ? raw : 0.5' to add NaN safety fallback

criteria: src-ts/reader/mcp/reader-endpoints.ts contains 'import { validateWeight }' or 'import { validateStringLength, validateWeight }' from input-validation
grep 'Number.isFinite' src-ts/reader/mcp/reader-endpoints.ts returns at least 1 match in adjustPersonaWeights
grep 'validateWeight' src-ts/reader/mcp/reader-endpoints.ts returns >= 5 matches (one per weight field)
convergence.definition_of_done: Persona weight inputs are validated with Number.isFinite + [0,1] range; adjustPersonaWeights has NaN safety fallback

files.change: Add validateWeight calls for 5 weight fields with min=0 max=1 after existing numeric type check
Add Number.isFinite guard on currentWeight read from persona.parameters

implementation: Add validateWeight to the import from input-validation.js (extend the existing import line from TASK-002)

In rsCreateCustomPersonaEndpoint, after the numericFields typeof check (line 548), add: for (const field of numericFields) { const err = validateWeight(parameters[field], 0, 1, 'parameters.' + field); if (err) return err; }

In adjustPersonaWeights (line 841), replace: const currentWeight = (persona.parameters[paramKey] as number | undefined) ?? 0.5; with: const raw = persona.parameters[paramKey]; const currentWeight = (typeof raw === 'number' && Number.isFinite(raw)) ? raw : 0.5;
Run existing reader endpoint tests to confirm no regression

reference.pattern: parseInt NaN semantic trap — NaN < 1 === false, NaN > 65535 === false; must use Number.isFinite()

rationale.chosen_approach: Add validateWeight to endpoint input validation (reject NaN/Infinity/out-of-range at the gate) AND add Number.isFinite fallback in adjustPersonaWeights (defense-in-depth against already-corrupted data)
decision_factors: Defense-in-depth: validate at input AND guard at computation
NaN can propagate from stored corrupted data even if input validation is added later

risks.risk: Existing test data with weight values like 0.5, 0.9 etc will pass fine; but any test that intentionally passes NaN or Infinity will now get 400 instead of proceeding
risks.mitigation: No existing tests intentionally pass NaN/Infinity to endpoint — check before implementing
